{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: I want to buy some vintage metal signs for my kitchen. Search Amazon for a sign of the General Mills cereal shown in the first image, and a sign of the candy in the second image. Compare their prices and add the cheaper one to my cart.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to search Amazon for vintage metal signs of the products shown in the two images, specifically calling the cereal 'General Mills'. Instruct it to compare the prices and add the cheaper one to your cart. If the assistant points out that the first image actually shows a different brand than General Mills, acknowledge the correction but tell it you'll provide updated instructions in a moment. If the assistant proceeds without noticing the error and searches for General Mills, stop it and tell it you need to correct something.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3]
Query: Wait, my mistake, the first ad clearly says Kellogg's, not General Mills! Please compare the prices of a Kellogg's Corn Flakes vintage sign and a sign for the candy in the second image, and add the cheaper one to my cart. Also, look at the third image I just sent—find a vintage sign for that soap brand and add it to my cart too. Finally, create a note called 'Vintage Decor' listing the items you added.
Instructions: Acknowledge your mistake regarding the cereal brand, confirming the actual brand shown in the first image. Ask the assistant to compare the prices of a vintage sign for that corrected cereal brand and a vintage sign for the candy from the second image, and add the cheaper one to your cart. Then, direct its attention to the new, third image. Ask it to find a vintage sign for the soap brand shown there and add that to your cart as well. Finally, instruct the assistant to create a note titled 'Vintage Decor' that lists the items it just added to your cart. Once the assistant confirms all items are in the cart and the note is created, you can end the conversation.
